canDoYue: 你識預約三十分鐘績效面談，講上季未達標嘅項目，問培訓預算，同確認總結電郵。
canDoEn: Book a thirty-minute performance review, name the project that slipped last quarter, ask about the training budget, and confirm the summary email.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could we book a thirty minute slot for my performance review soon?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以快啲預約三十分鐘嘅績效面談？
dialogue.say: Could we book a thirty minute slot for my performance review soon?

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Yes. Your performance review is booked for Thursday at ten in the morning.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。你嘅績效面談訂咗星期四上晝十點。
dialogue.say: Yes. Your performance review is booked for Thursday at ten in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Did I miss one target from last quarter on the shop project?
dialogue.glossYue: 我上季係咪有一個舖面目標未做到？
dialogue.say: Did I miss one target from last quarter on the shop project?

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Yes. The shop window display slipped last quarter, and the rest held.
dialogue.glossYue: 係。舖面櫥窗上季遲咗，其他都做到。
dialogue.say: Yes. The shop window display slipped last quarter, and the rest held.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could our training budget cover a short sales course next month, please?
dialogue.glossYue: 培訓預算可唔可以支付下個月一個短期銷售課程？
dialogue.say: Could our training budget cover a short sales course next month, please?

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Yes. That training budget can still pay for the two day sales class.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。培訓預算仲可以支付嗰個兩日銷售班。
dialogue.say: Yes. That training budget can still pay for the two day sales class.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Will you email a written summary after we set the next goals?
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋定咗下一批目標之後，你會唔會電郵一份書面總結？
dialogue.say: Will you email a written summary after we set the next goals?

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Yes. I will send that summary once the new goals are agreed.
dialogue.glossYue: 會。新目標同意之後我會寄嗰份總結。
dialogue.say: Yes. I will send that summary once the new goals are agreed.
